cards.name: Enter Text
cards.summary: Lets the user type a single line of text into a labeled field.

cards.name: Enter Paragraph
cards.summary: Lets the user type multiple lines of text into a labeled box.

cards.name: Enter Number
cards.summary: Lets the user type or adjust a numeric value with optional min and max.

cards.name: Pick Date
cards.summary: Lets the user select a date from a calendar popup.

cards.name: Pick Time
cards.summary: Lets the user select a time of day from hour and minute controls.

cards.name: Enter Email Address
cards.summary: Lets the user type an email address into a validated field.

cards.name: Enter Phone Number
cards.summary: Lets the user type a phone number into a formatted field.

cards.name: Enter Currency Amount
cards.summary: Lets the user type a monetary value with currency symbol and formatting.

cards.name: Pick Date Range
cards.summary: Lets the user choose a start date and an end date together from one calendar.

cards.name: Choose From Dropdown
cards.summary: Lets the user pick one option from a collapsible list.

cards.name: Select Multiple Options
cards.summary: Lets the user check multiple items from a displayed list.

cards.name: Choose One Option
cards.summary: Lets the user select exactly one choice from visible radio buttons.

cards.name: Toggle Checkbox
cards.summary: Lets the user check or uncheck a single yes or no option.

cards.name: Pick From Searchable List
cards.summary: Lets the user type to narrow a long list and pick one entry.

cards.name: Rate With Stars
cards.summary: Lets the user choose a rating by clicking one to five stars.

cards.name: Arrange In Grid
cards.summary: Displays child cards in rows and columns with equal spacing.

cards.name: Stack In Panel
cards.summary: Groups child cards vertically in a bordered section with optional title.

cards.name: Organize In Tabs
cards.summary: Shows one group of cards at a time under clickable tab labels.

cards.name: Split Into Columns
cards.summary: Divides the space into side by side sections for child cards.

cards.name: Collapse Section
cards.summary: Hides or shows child cards when the user clicks the section header.

cards.name: Set App Title
cards.summary: Sets the name shown at the top of the app and in the window title.

cards.name: Show Records Table
cards.summary: Displays rows of data in sortable columns with optional pagination.

cards.name: List Records
cards.summary: Shows data items one per row with icon and text summary.

cards.name: Display Record Card
cards.summary: Presents a single record's fields in labeled rows or compact layout.

cards.name: Show Detail View
cards.summary: Displays all fields of one selected record in organized sections.

cards.name: Show Status Badge
cards.summary: Displays a colored label indicating state like pending approved or shipped.

cards.name: Display Barcode From Code
cards.summary: Shows a barcode image created from the product code or identifier of a record.

cards.name: Click Button
cards.summary: Triggers an action when the user clicks the labeled button.

cards.name: Switch Toggle
cards.summary: Lets the user turn a setting on or off with a sliding switch.

cards.name: Adjust Slider
cards.summary: Lets the user pick a value by dragging a handle along a range.

cards.name: Choose File
cards.summary: Lets the user browse and select a local file for upload or reading.

cards.name: Confirm Action
cards.summary: Asks the user to approve or cancel before proceeding with an action.

cards.name: Show Message Banner
cards.summary: Displays a dismissible notice with success warning or error styling.

cards.name: Show Progress While Running
cards.summary: Displays a progress bar or spinner during a long running step like importing data.

cards.name: Convert Field Type
cards.summary: Changes a field from one data type to another, such as text to number or date to text.

cards.name: Format Currency Value
cards.summary: Displays a number as currency with symbol, decimal places, and thousands separator.

cards.name: Extract Substring
cards.summary: Pulls out a portion of text from a field using start position and length.

cards.name: Combine Multiple Fields
cards.summary: Joins two or more fields into one with optional separator text between them.

cards.name: Round Numeric Value
cards.summary: Rounds a number to a specified number of decimal places or to the nearest whole number.

cards.name: Trim Whitespace
cards.summary: Removes leading and trailing spaces or line breaks from a text field.

cards.name: Change Text Case
cards.summary: Converts text to uppercase, lowercase, or title case as specified.

cards.name: Generate Unique Identifier
cards.summary: Creates a unique code for each new record from a prefix and a counter saved with the table.

cards.name: Extract Domain From Email
cards.summary: Pulls the domain portion from an email address field for grouping or filtering.

cards.name: Format Phone Number
cards.summary: Standardizes phone numbers to a consistent display format with area code and separators.

cards.name: Filter Records By Condition
cards.summary: Keeps only the records in the current list that meet one or more conditions and drops the rest.

cards.name: Sort Records By Field
cards.summary: Arranges the records in the current list in ascending or descending order of one or more fields.

cards.name: Group Records By Value
cards.summary: Organizes records into named groups based on a shared field value or category.

cards.name: Remove Duplicate Records
cards.summary: Identifies and removes records with matching values in specified fields from the list.

cards.name: Paginate Record List
cards.summary: Splits a list into fixed-size pages and returns one page at a time.

cards.name: Take Record Range
cards.summary: Returns part of a list of records, from the start position up to (not including) the end position.

cards.name: Find First Matching Record
cards.summary: Searches a list and returns the first record that meets the specified condition.

cards.name: Flag Unusual Records
cards.summary: Marks records whose value falls outside a normal range the builder sets, such as far above the average.

cards.name: Merge Two Lists
cards.summary: Combines two lists of records into one list, optionally dropping repeated records.

cards.name: Calculate Sum Of Field
cards.summary: Adds up numeric values from a specified field across all records in a list.

cards.name: Calculate Average Value
cards.summary: Computes the mean of numeric values from a field across a set of records.

cards.name: Calculate Percentage Of Total
cards.summary: Divides a value by a sum and expresses the result as a percentage.

cards.name: Find Minimum Value
cards.summary: Identifies the smallest numeric value in a field across a list of records.

cards.name: Find Maximum Value
cards.summary: Identifies the largest numeric value in a field across a list of records.

cards.name: Calculate Running Total
cards.summary: Adds each value to the sum of all previous values in sequence.

cards.name: Calculate Stock Level
cards.summary: Computes current inventory by subtracting outgoing quantity from incoming quantity and starting balance.

cards.name: Count Records Matching Condition
cards.summary: Counts the records in the current list, or only those that meet a condition.

cards.name: Calculate Reorder Quantity
cards.summary: Works out the next order amount from past usage with a plain formula, such as average use times lead time.

cards.name: Calculate From Two Values
cards.summary: Adds, subtracts, multiplies or divides two numbers, such as stock counted minus stock on record.

cards.name: Change Value By Percent
cards.summary: Raises or lowers an amount by a percentage, for example to add tax or take off a discount.

cards.name: Calculate Percentage Change
cards.summary: Shows how much a value rose or fell compared with an earlier value, as a percentage.

cards.name: Split Text By Separator
cards.summary: Splits text into separate values wherever a separator such as a comma, tab or vertical bar appears.

cards.name: Search Text For Pattern
cards.summary: Finds whether a text field contains a specified word, phrase, or pattern.

cards.name: Replace Text In Field
cards.summary: Substitutes all occurrences of specified text with replacement text in a field.

cards.name: Split Text Into Lines
cards.summary: Breaks multi-line text into separate strings, one per line, for individual processing.

cards.name: Fill Text Template
cards.summary: Inserts field values into a template with placeholders to generate formatted text output.

cards.name: Extract Number From Text
cards.summary: Finds the first whole or decimal number in a text field and ignores the other characters.

cards.name: Remove Special Characters
cards.summary: Strips out non-alphanumeric characters from text, keeping only letters, numbers, and spaces.

cards.name: Label Text By Keywords
cards.summary: Gives each text record a label by matching keywords from a list the builder sets.

cards.name: Calculate Date Difference
cards.summary: Computes the number of days, hours, or minutes between two dates or timestamps.

cards.name: Add Time To Date
cards.summary: Advances a date forward by a specified number of days, hours, or minutes.

cards.name: Subtract Time From Date
cards.summary: Moves a date backward by a specified number of days, hours, or minutes.

cards.name: Compare Two Dates
cards.summary: Determines whether one date is before, after, or equal to another date.

cards.name: Calculate Working Days
cards.summary: Counts weekdays between two dates, excluding weekends and optionally holidays.

cards.name: Get Current Date And Time
cards.summary: Returns the date and time as the app clock says it is now.

cards.name: Merge Two Records
cards.summary: Combines fields from two records into one, with options for handling duplicate field names.

cards.name: Build Record From Fields
cards.summary: Creates a new record by selecting and assembling individual field values.

cards.name: Rename Record Fields
cards.summary: Changes field names in a record to new names while keeping values unchanged.

cards.name: Keep Only Selected Fields
cards.summary: Keeps only the named fields of a record and drops all the others.

cards.name: Join Records Into List
cards.summary: Collects multiple individual records into a single list for batch processing.

cards.name: Route By Status Value
cards.summary: Sends a record to the output for its status value; records with any other status go to a no-match output.

cards.name: Route By Numeric Range
cards.summary: Sends a record to the output whose number range it falls in; records outside every range go to a no-match output.

cards.name: Route By Text Match
cards.summary: Sends a record to an output when a text field matches a chosen value; other records go to a no-match output.

cards.name: Route By Field Presence
cards.summary: Sends a record one way if a field has a value and another way if it is empty.

cards.name: Route By Date Comparison
cards.summary: Sends a record to an output depending on whether a date is in the past, today or in the future.

cards.name: Route By Category
cards.summary: Sends a record to the output for its category or type; records with an unlisted category go to a no-match output.

cards.name: Route By List Membership
cards.summary: Sends a record one way if a field value appears in a reference list and another way if it does not.

cards.name: Handle Error Without Stopping
cards.summary: Catches a failure in a step so the rest of the flow can carry on along an error path.

cards.name: Set Default Value On Error
cards.summary: Provides a fallback value when a field calculation or transformation fails.

cards.name: Retry Failed Step
cards.summary: Runs a failed local step again a set number of times, only if it is safe to repeat, then follows the error path.

cards.name: Log Error Details
cards.summary: Records information about a failure for review without stopping the application flow.

cards.name: Flag Record With Error
cards.summary: Marks a record as having encountered a problem and continues processing remaining records.

cards.name: Skip Invalid Record
cards.summary: Removes a record from further processing when it fails validation or transformation.

cards.name: Collect Error Records
cards.summary: Gathers all records that encountered errors into a separate list for review.

cards.name: Define Data Table
cards.summary: Creates a new table with a name and description to hold records in the app.

cards.name: Add Field To Table
cards.summary: Adds a named column to a table with a data type, and optional simple rules such as required or a number range.

cards.name: Set Field Default Value
cards.summary: Assigns a default value that fills automatically when creating a new record in the table.

cards.name: Link Tables By Relationship
cards.summary: Connects two tables so records in one can reference records in the other.

cards.name: Define Choice List
cards.summary: Creates a dropdown list of allowed values that a field can use across the app.

cards.name: Add Calculated Field
cards.summary: Defines a field whose value is worked out from other fields in the same record, using a formula the builder sets.

cards.name: Enable Change History Tracking
cards.summary: Makes a table keep the last few versions of each record, with when each change was made.

cards.name: Define App Settings
cards.summary: Keeps the owner's app-wide options, such as default currency or reorder level, in one saved settings record.

cards.name: Create New Record
cards.summary: Adds a single record to a table with values the user provides or maps from inputs.

cards.name: Read Record By ID
cards.summary: Retrieves one record from a table using its unique identifier.

cards.name: Update Existing Record
cards.summary: Changes field values in a record the user selects or identifies.

cards.name: Delete Record
cards.summary: Removes a record from the table permanently; a record other records still point to is refused.

cards.name: Create Multiple Records
cards.summary: Adds several records to a table at once from a list or imported data.

cards.name: Create Or Update Record
cards.summary: Creates a record if no saved record has the same key value, or updates that record if one does.

cards.name: Archive Record
cards.summary: Moves a record to inactive status without deleting it so it can be restored later.

cards.name: Restore Archived Record
cards.summary: Returns an archived record to active status in the table.

cards.name: Copy Record
cards.summary: Creates a new record by copying an existing one, so the user can change a few fields.

cards.name: Update Field Across Records
cards.summary: Changes one field to a new value in several selected or filtered records at once.

cards.name: Delete Multiple Records
cards.summary: Removes several selected or filtered records at once after a confirmation.

cards.name: Restore Previous Record Version
cards.summary: Puts a record back to an earlier kept version, such as how it was before its last saved change.

cards.name: Query Saved Records By Criteria
cards.summary: Reads the saved records of a table that match one or more conditions, joined with AND or OR.

cards.name: Join Related Tables
cards.summary: Combines records from two related tables into one result set for display or export.

cards.name: Search Saved Records By Text
cards.summary: Finds saved records where any text field contains the words or phrase the user enters.

cards.name: Group And Summarize Saved Data
cards.summary: Groups saved records by a field and calculates totals, averages or counts for each group.

cards.name: Set Primary Key Field
cards.summary: Designates a field as the unique identifier that every record must have.

cards.name: Enforce Unique Field Value
cards.summary: Makes the saved table itself refuse two records with the same value in the specified field.

cards.name: Reference Linked Record
cards.summary: Makes sure a field value points to a record that exists in the linked table.

cards.name: Prevent Accidental Delete
cards.summary: Blocks deletion of a record if other records reference it or a condition is met.

cards.name: Import Records From CSV
cards.summary: Loads records into a table from a CSV file the user selects; files that are too large are refused.

cards.name: Import Records From JSON
cards.summary: Reads records from a JSON file the user picks and adds them to the table; files that are too large are refused.

cards.name: Export Table To CSV
cards.summary: Saves a whole table, the records matching a filter, or the records on screen to a CSV file the user picks.

cards.name: Export Table To JSON
cards.summary: Saves a whole table, the records matching a filter, or the records on screen to a JSON file the user picks.

cards.name: Load Sample Data Set
cards.summary: Fills a table with example records so the user can test the app immediately.

cards.name: Check Field Is Required
cards.summary: Stops the user if a mandatory field is left empty before saving or submitting.

cards.name: Validate Field Type
cards.summary: Confirms a field contains the correct data type such as number, text, or date.

cards.name: Match Format Pattern
cards.summary: Checks a field against a pattern like email address, phone number, or code format.

cards.name: Validate Number Range
cards.summary: Ensures a numeric field falls between a minimum and maximum value.

cards.name: Check Text Length
cards.summary: Verifies a text field meets minimum or maximum character count limits.

cards.name: Validate Against Allowed List
cards.summary: Confirms a field value exists in a predefined list of acceptable options.

cards.name: Reject Future Date
cards.summary: Prevents a date field from being set to a date beyond today.

cards.name: Compare Two Fields
cards.summary: Checks whether two fields meet a condition like greater than, equal to, or not matching.

cards.name: Verify Sum Equals Total
cards.summary: Confirms that line item amounts add up to a specified total field.

cards.name: Require Either Or Field
cards.summary: Ensures at least one of two fields is filled, but not necessarily both.

cards.name: Require Dependent Field
cards.summary: Makes a second field mandatory, and marks it required on screen, only when a first field has a certain value.

cards.name: Validate Date Order
cards.summary: Confirms a start date comes before an end date or ship date follows order date.

cards.name: Prevent Negative Stock
cards.summary: Blocks inventory updates that would result in stock quantity falling below zero.

cards.name: Flag Reorder Level Reached
cards.summary: Signals when inventory quantity drops to or below the reorder threshold.

cards.name: Require Approval Above Amount
cards.summary: Marks an order or transaction for manual approval if value exceeds a set limit.

cards.name: Prevent Duplicate Order
cards.summary: Prevents creating a new order when one with the same key details already exists.

cards.name: Enforce Lead Time Limit
cards.summary: Ensures a delivery or completion date allows enough days from the order date.

cards.name: Check Valid Status Transition
cards.summary: Confirms a status change follows allowed steps like pending to shipped to delivered.

cards.name: Show Or Hide Field
cards.summary: Decides whether a field appears on screen based on another field or record state.

cards.name: Enable Or Disable Field
cards.summary: Controls whether a field can be edited depending on conditions like record status.

cards.name: Confirm Destructive Action
cards.summary: Asks the user to confirm before a high-impact step, such as deleting several records.

cards.name: Stop On Error Threshold
cards.summary: Halts processing when the count of validation or import errors exceeds a set limit.

cards.name: Run When Button Pressed
cards.summary: Starts a flow when the user clicks a button in the application interface.

cards.name: Run When Form Submitted
cards.summary: Starts a flow when the user submits a form with input values.

cards.name: Run When Page Opened
cards.summary: Starts a flow when the user navigates to a specific page in the application.

cards.name: Run When Record Selected
cards.summary: Starts a flow when the user chooses a record from a list or table.

cards.name: Run On A Timer
cards.summary: Runs a flow once after a delay, or again and again at a fixed interval, only while the app preview is running.

cards.name: Run At App Start
cards.summary: Runs a flow automatically when the app preview begins running.

cards.name: Run When Record Created
cards.summary: Starts a flow when a new record is added while the app preview is running.

cards.name: Run When Record Changed
cards.summary: Starts a flow when an existing record is updated while the app preview is running.

cards.name: Run When Record Deleted
cards.summary: Starts a flow when a record is removed while the app preview is running.

cards.name: Run When Value Crosses Threshold
cards.summary: Starts a flow when a numeric field goes above or below a limit while the app preview is running.

cards.name: Run Steps In Sequence
cards.summary: Runs the connected steps one after another, in the order the user set.

cards.name: Wait For All Steps To Complete
cards.summary: Waits until every branch the flow actually took has finished, then carries on.

cards.name: Wait For Condition With Timeout
cards.summary: Pauses until a condition becomes true or the required time limit runs out, whichever comes first.

cards.name: Repeat For Each List Item
cards.summary: Runs the connected steps once for each record in a list, up to a limit set when building.

cards.name: Build Order Request
cards.summary: Formats order data into a structured request ready for a person to submit to a supplier.

cards.name: Build Shipment Notice
cards.summary: Formats shipment details into a notice ready for a person to send to a recipient.

cards.name: Build Supplier Message
cards.summary: Formats supplier communication data into a message ready for a person to send.

cards.name: Build Spreadsheet Export
cards.summary: Formats records into a table ready for a person to paste into a spreadsheet.

cards.name: Build Email Text
cards.summary: Formats data into email-ready text ready for a person to copy and send.

cards.name: Build Data File
cards.summary: Formats records into a file ready for a person to upload to another tool.

cards.name: Show Manual Steps
cards.summary: Displays step-by-step instructions for a person to follow outside the app.

cards.name: Show Copyable Text
cards.summary: Displays text in a copyable block for a person to paste elsewhere.

cards.name: Show Action Checklist
cards.summary: Displays a checklist of tasks for a person to complete outside the app.

cards.name: Show Waiting Item
cards.summary: Displays an item paused until a person completes an outside action.

cards.name: Show Pending Reminder
cards.summary: Displays a reminder of actions still waiting for a person to complete outside.

cards.name: Enter Outside Result
cards.summary: Shows a form where a person types the result of an outside action, such as a reference number or confirmed quantity.

cards.name: Import Result File
cards.summary: Lets a person pick and import a result file from an outside action.

cards.name: Match Result To Item
cards.summary: Matches a result entered by a person to the waiting item that triggered it.

cards.name: Reject Invalid Result
cards.summary: Rejects a result entered by a person if it is for another item, built on an older version of the item, or too old.

cards.name: Reconcile Stale Result
cards.summary: Shows what changed in a record since an outside action began, and lets the user accept or discard the result.

cards.name: Resume After Result
cards.summary: Continues the flow after a person enters a result from an outside action.

cards.name: Mark Item Outcome
cards.summary: Marks an item as done or failed based on the result a person entered.

cards.name: Log Outside Action
cards.summary: Records a history entry when a person completes an outside action.

cards.name: Show Still Pending
cards.summary: Displays items still waiting for a person to complete outside actions.

cards.name: Suggest Record Layout
cards.summary: Validates and normalizes a table schema proposal from the build-time generator.

cards.name: Draft Sample Records
cards.summary: Validates example records from the build-time generator against the schema.

cards.name: Propose Field Mappings
cards.summary: Validates and normalizes field mapping proposals from the build-time generator.

cards.name: Draft Validation Rules
cards.summary: Validates and normalizes validation rule proposals from the build-time generator.

cards.name: Draft Acceptance Checklist
cards.summary: Validates and normalizes an acceptance checklist proposal from the build-time generator.

cards.name: Explain App In Plain Words
cards.summary: Validates and normalizes an app explanation from the build-time generator.

cards.name: Draft Field Help Text
cards.summary: Validates and normalizes field help text from the build-time generator.

cards.name: Prepare AI Prompt
cards.summary: Formats record fields into a prompt for a person to copy to an outside AI tool.

cards.name: Accept AI Answer
cards.summary: Receives text from an outside AI tool and parses it into the specified format.

cards.name: Check Answer Shape
cards.summary: Checks that an AI answer has the expected structure before use.

cards.name: Open Detail Screen
cards.summary: Displays the full record view when the user selects an item from a list.

cards.name: Go Back To List
cards.summary: Returns the user to the previous list or overview screen.

cards.name: Open Pop-Up Panel
cards.summary: Shows a temporary overlay window for quick edits or details without leaving the current screen.

cards.name: Summary Table
cards.summary: Presents key totals and counts in a table layout for quick overview.

cards.name: Chart Over Time
cards.summary: Displays a line or bar chart showing how a measure changes across dates or periods.

cards.name: Grouped Totals View
cards.summary: Shows aggregated counts or sums organized by category or location.

cards.name: Exception List
cards.summary: Lists low-stock, overdue or out-of-limit records that need attention.

cards.name: Print-Friendly Page
cards.summary: Formats the current view for clean printing, without menus or navigation elements.
